accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:root-t-width
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The whole-polytope maximal inequality and its displayed constant are not asserted as proved by the conditional width theorem; their resolution is the first open-ended solve target.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The 1024B d^(dk)/(epsilon sqrt(T)) expected-width certificate is claimed only if oeq:polytope-maximal-inequality establishes its displayed uniform maximal inequality; a negative resolution instead requires the stated sharp replacement-rate result on the unchanged class.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For the special dishonest-casino HMM, the time-average EWAC is partially identified at finite T and becomes SCM-independent as T tends to infinity, so its lower and upper time-average bounds converge.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives a finite canonical-SCM reduction and tight polynomial-program bounds for discrete counterfactual queries.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper optimizes counterfactual bounds over compatible causal mechanisms in a dynamic latent-state model with time-invariant copulas, for a terminal probability-of-necessity query; it does not state a record-length contraction rate.
The paper develops calibrated-projection confidence intervals with uniform asymptotic coverage for projections of partially identified moment models.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Resolve the synchronizer--two-permutation square first, either with a complete corner-integrable predictable-scale covering argument or a horizon-dependent counterselection and replacement rate.
Add a formal embedding or non-embedding proposition relating the stationary response-SCM class to the dishonest-casino model, so the finite-uniform improvement is transparent rather than contextual.
Give an explicit finite-dimensional endpoint-computation formulation and complexity bound for the stationary shared-response program to make the confidence-fiber component operational.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with the synchronizer--two-permutation square as the first solve obligation; retain thm:root-t-width only in its accepted conditional form.
